attempting-to-enter-the-arena-before-tal.npc: Oi! Where d'you think you're going? Come and speak to me before you go wondering through there. You'll get yourself killed!

attempting-to-use-the-bank-chest-without.npc: Oi, get yer hands off that! It's reserved for survivors of the Colosseum.

attempting-to-use-the-bank-chest-without.text: You do not have enough Glory to use that.

first-time-dialogue.npc: This place...? Why, This is the great Fortis Colosseum!
Adventurers come from near and far to test their might within these walls.
Indeed it is. If you are victorious in the Colosseum, the whole of Varlamore shall hear of your name.

first-time-dialogue.player: I imagine its quite the challenge then?

first-time-dialogue.npc: It'll put your skills to the test alright.
Just head through that tunnel behind me and we'll get the show started! Make sure you've got everything you need. Once you're in you can't leave until the end of a wave!
Come and ask if you have any other questions.

options.text: Can you tell me about modifiers?

steps.player: Can you tell me about modifiers?

steps.npc: Yes! After all, they were my idea...
Every time you complete a wave, I'll offer you a choice of three modifiers.
Each modifier will increase the challenge for the rest of the run - So choose wisely!
Some modifiers can be offered multiple times, with the effects then growing in power!
Was there anything else?
Well it's a bit different to just killing monsters and picking up items, as I'm sure you're used to...
After each wave inside the Colosseum, I'll show you the rewards you have earned, as well as what you'll earn from the next wave...
If you aren't confident that you can complete the next wave, you can claim your existing rewards and exit early.
However, if you're confident you can beat the next wave, you can risk your whole reward pile to get even more!
Be careful though. If you die or leave the arena before claiming your loot from me, you will lose all of the rewards you've earned.

steps.player: So I'm guessing the higher the wave, the better the rewards?

steps.npc: Oh, you're good. Exactly that!
Even better - if you manage to finish all of the waves and the final challenge, then you'll be awarded with Dizana's Quiver.
It's a handy piece of kit that you wear on your back to store extra bolts or arrows.

steps.player: That does sound handy! Thanks for explaining all of that.

steps.npc: Anytime, Rookie. Anything else?
It's the measure of your progress inside the Colosseum.
Speak to Gloria over there if you want to know the details.

options.text: What do you do around here?

steps.player: What do you do around here?

steps.npc: I'm Minimus. It's not my real name of course, but it seems to have stuck. I started out competing here as a gladiator when I was a young'n. After that I became one of the lanistas.
The ones responsible for overseeing the selecting and training of the gladiators.
Eventually, the kingdom gave me the role of Colosseum Master. I still make sure to fit some fighting in, but now I have the honor of managing the fights themselves.

steps.player: So are you not training like the rest of the gladiators?

steps.npc: I have no need! I'm already one of the greatest fighters to grace this arena.

steps.player: Are you at a disadvantage because of your height?

steps.npc: No! How dare you even suggest that! Those spindly human bodies are unfit to go toe to toe with a fine dwarf like myself!
Now, did you need anything else?
Farewell, Rookie.

options.text: What do you do around here?

upon-entering-the-arena.npc: Let me know when you want to begin.

steps.npc: It was a valiant effort, [rank]. I've popped all your earned rewards into that chest over there. You can retrieve them from it when ready.

steps.player: On second thoughts, I'd better stay.
